summary: SunCar Technology Group furnished a Form 6-K disclosing that CFO and director Bohong Du resigned effective September 16, 2026, for personal reasons with no stated disagreements; Eric H. Zhang became CFO on September 18, 2026, stepping down as independent director and from Audit, Compensation and Nominating committee roles while remaining a non-independent director. Xuefeng Qian was appointed independent director and chairs Compensation and Nominating committees, with annual cash compensation of RMB120,000 (about USD17,700) and no related-party transactions or side arrangements disclosed. The abrupt CFO change is the event; watch for follow-on disclosures on internal controls, audit committee independence and any restatement or accounting risk.
